digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and fallback chains
propositions: A class with a configured fallback array must construct a pydantic-ai FallbackModel whose default is the primary model and whose fallbacks are inline model configs (model + provider + endpoint tuples).

The fallback_on predicate must be derived from the existing failure.py _RETRYABLE frozenset union CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL, firing on transport errors (RETRY_NOW), rate-limits and server errors (WAIT_AND_RETRY), and model unavailability, but NOT on credential or input-size errors.

Capabilities (e.g. supports_temperature) must be computed as the conservative intersection across all candidates (primary + fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is built, so a capability withdrawn by any candidate is withdrawn for the entire chain.

The FallbackModel must be used as an async context manager so pydantic-ai's providers are entered and exited correctly, and rebar-created transports remain on ProviderSession._closeables, closed exactly once.

provider_provenance must record the ordered candidate list and read ran_model from ModelResponse.model_name (not FallbackModel.model_name), so a verdict produced by a fallback attests the model that actually answered.
A class without fallback configuration must build an unwrapped model with no behavioral change from today.
